rationale: The agent found that GC content separates the classes (0.41 vs 0.55). A logistic regression on nucleotide frequencies alone reached 1.00 accuracy on the test set, so the model's 0.99 adds nothing over composition. It proposed GC-matched negatives and k-mer baselines as the remedy. It also raised valid issues the key doesn't mention: there is no model code or predictions, so the 0.99 can't be reproduced, and nothing supports the attention-map or novel-discovery claims.
